citations.claim: at violation step body x exceeds arena edge beyond tolerance
just before violation overshoot still within limit

counterfactual.change: Reduced initial vx from 8.88 to 3.0 so per-step displacement smaller; boundary bounce occurs before exceeding 0.15 tolerance

explanation: With no walls, body moves at high horizontal speed (~8.9 m/s). Substepped Euler integration advances position past arena boundary before collision/bounce is applied; at step 68 overshoot 0.126 within tolerance, at step 69 overshoot 0.179 exceeds 0.15 limit. Reducing velocity prevents overshoot, confirming cause is insufficient boundary collision handling for fast bodies relying on wall boxes.
vision_note: The red body travels rightward and contacts the right arena boundary, then visibly protrudes through it at step 68 and further exits the arena at step 69. No other bodies, walls, or waypoints are visible; the failure is a simple horizontal boundary crossing.
